scope: Localization diagnostic on previously evaluated Round7 questions, not an independent benchmark or SOTA claim

annotation.risk_definition: Unsupported or contradicted by currently supplied evidence; not necessarily world-false
annotation.new_gold: Minimal risky expression spans; retain whole claim scope
annotation.annotators: Assistant agents with independent second review and root adjudication; not human gold
annotation.supported_items: Reuse prior reviewed item label with empty spans
annotation.abstained_tentative_unresolved: Excluded from primary denominator; alert behavior described separately

token_unit.tokenizer: Original generated Qwen BPE IDs and character offsets; no retokenization
token_unit.eligible: Token intersects resolved item and contains Unicode alphanumeric character; mixed excluded lexical overlap excluded
token_unit.positive: Alphanumeric character overlap with risk span
token_unit.negative: Outside marked risky expression, not independently verified word truth
token_unit.cross_item: Count once; risk-label OR; broadcast score max

methods.broadcast: All 14 frozen Round7 item predictors, each original item score repeated over its tokens
methods.mlp_aggregation: Report each seed and mean/sample standard deviation; do not average probabilities or select best test seed

timing.hidden_lookback_redeep: Post-read current token; no future-answer input
timing.lumina_nll_entropy: Predictive position immediately before current observed token, original Round7 alignment
timing.broadcast: Post-hoc control; uses item-end score and can include later tokens within item
timing.prefix_audit: Original item-end allclose; short-prefix cosine diagnostic; fixed-length future-token perturbation checks current states invariant

threshold_regimes.original_threshold: Original frozen Round7 item thresholds applied unchanged
threshold_regimes.validation_token_threshold: Choose one threshold per predictor using only validation token micro F1 over all resolved items; ties higher precision then higher threshold; fixed constant thresholds 0.5

metrics.excluded_text: Alert behavior descriptive only, no review strategy changes

bootstrap.unit: Original group_id, preserve paired conditions and all their tokens
outputs: micro_F1 in both scopes and threshold regimes
native token minus own broadcast micro_F1 paired difference
bootstrap.mlp: Each seed independently; report seed mean and sample SD separately

reporting.do_not_claim_native_method_reproduction: These are frozen Round7 feature adaptations to per-token scoring
reporting.data_limit: 147/200 main groups ask birth years (73.5%); short contexts and source presence cues remain
reporting.next_step: Use diagnosis to choose improvements; evaluate on a new, more diverse held-out corpus before superiority claims
